description:
Adds arched doors

# Simple Arcs
This mod adds arc-nodes to Minetest as well as arcs for inner and outer corners.
Note this is a fork of PEAK's mod Simple Arcs (pkarcs) https://forum.luanti.org/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=14541 which adds arched doors made to work specifically with the mod.

## Dependencies
- default (included in minetest_game)
- doors (included in minetest_game)
- xpanes (included in minetest_game)
- mesecons (**optional dependency!**)
